source.title: Belfast and Ulster Directory 1950, p. 1419 (Donaghadee, Urban District Council)
source.publisher: Belfast and Ulster Directory (Belfast News-Letter); copy at Belfast Central Library
source.check: photo read: eight names in the urban council list; five match the South Ward members on file

note: Triennial urban council election of May 1949: South Ward is on file; North Ward was polled but its result has not been found. The Belfast and Ulster Directory 1950 lists eight members; the five South Ward members on file are among them, leaving three for North Ward. Three of four seats (the fourth North Ward member is not in the directory list: vacancy, omission or a South/North error cannot be told). North Ward was polled, so votes and any defeated candidates are unknown. W. Campbell was a defeated North Ward candidate in 1952 and C. C. Stewart a North Ward member in 1939 and 1952, which fits. Directory list, not an election report: the directory prints the council's membership as it stood when the edition was compiled (late in the year after the election). It does not say whether members were returned at a poll or unopposed, and cannot show co-options made between the election and compilation. No votes.
